title: Sync Imports Your Ticked Rows
subtitle: A tick plus a Category is now all a bank row needs; the next sync takes it into Transactions. Childcare becomes Nanny only. One upgrade, one sync.
intro: After the pull request merges, the code is already in your Sheet. The upgrade retires the unused Childcare lines and refreshes the dropdowns; a sync then imports the rows you already ticked.

**What does not change:** no rows, balances or entered values. Tab names and column headers stay the same. Retired subcategories stay on the Categories tab, unticked, so nothing that used them breaks.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before sync-imports 2026-11-09`.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
steps.note: The report should include lines like "List All Subcategories (auto): formula updated" and "Categories: Childcare / Daycare / Preschool is no longer in the taxonomy; Active? unticked".

steps.text: Open the **Categories** tab. Under Childcare only **Nanny** is still ticked Active?. Open the Subcategory dropdown on any Transactions row: Daycare / Preschool, Babysitting, Before & After School Care and Other Childcare are no longer offered.
steps.done: Only Nanny appears under Childcare in the dropdowns.

sections.heading: Let a sync import your ticked rows

steps.text: Open **Finance Tracker → Bank feed → Sync now**. The message now has a line "Rows you ticked Reviewed?: N imported into Transactions." The two paychecks, the Childcare Venmo and the Child Expenses Venmo you ticked should all go in; the Independent Bank card payment goes in through its new rule.
steps.done: On Transactions, the Childcare row shows Subcategory Nanny and Spending Type Fixed; the Child Expenses row shows Subcategory Other with a note that it was defaulted. The Dashboard banner count drops.

steps.text: From now on, reviewing a bank row is: pick a Category, tick Reviewed?, done. The nightly sync (or Sync now) imports it. Pick a Subcategory only when you care which line it lands on; otherwise the category's "Other" line is used and noted.
steps.note: Rows that still need something you cannot default (a Fund for a Savings row, a Debt for a Debt Payment) are listed in the Sync now message so you know what to fill in.
